title: Separate shell yield cadence from process lifetime
failure_signature: A one-second process timeout killed the first full-suite invocation before it could produce a test receipt.
trigger_preconditions: a repository suite can exceed the commentary cadence
the shell tool supports asynchronous output yielding
the process itself must remain bounded but alive
candidate_workaround: Give the test process a realistic bounded lifetime, let the orchestration layer yield after ten seconds, and poll the live cell while sending concise progress updates.
recurrence_guard: Use tool yielding for responsiveness and reserve process timeouts for genuine upper bounds; never substitute one for the other.
rollback: Terminate the live cell if it exceeds the declared upper bound, preserve the incomplete log, and do not call it a test result.
scope_boundary: Timeout recovery establishes only bounded process completion; it cannot improve the scientific or authority status of the tested artifacts.
